newsitem.title: USA: Group to buy Xpedite in $250 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Group to buy Xpedite in $250 mln deal.

text.p: Senior management of Xpedite Systems Inc said Friday that it has reached a definitive merger agreement to acquire the company for $23.25 per share, a deal valued at $250 million including indebtedness.

The management team is acquiring the company as part of an investment group comprised of Fenway Partners Inc, a privately held New York-based investment firm, and UBS Partners LLC, a subsidiary of Union Bank of Switzerland.
Xpedite said that the group will also acquire its United Kingdom affiliate, Xpedite Systems Ltd, for $87 million.
Both transactions are expected to close in the fourth quarter, said the company, and are subject to regulatory and shareholder approval, and the completion of financing.
Xpedite is an international provider of computer and fax-based services focused mainly on high-volume document distribution.
